## What's new

KrutzOtrem's MIT Brick overlays for Game Boy, GBC, GBA, Game Gear and Neo Geo
Pocket Color join SkyWalker541's, credited in CREDITS.md and
res/overlays/SOURCE.md.

Every overlay ChaOS ships that is missing from the card's Overlays folders is
put back once per version, at the first start after an install or update -
this release's and every earlier one's, so one deleted by accident comes back
with the next update. Files of the same name are never overwritten.

Updates over Wi-Fi are now small when they can be: a release whose system is
the card's (ChaOS/SYSTEM, a hash of the root without ChaOS's own files)
sends only ChaOS's files - about 6 MB instead of 40 - which the launcher
checks, unpacks beside the card's and copies into place file by file,
launch.sh and VERSION last, before restarting. A copy cut short is finished
at the next start. A release that changes the system underneath still sends
the whole system, installed at boot as before. This update itself is a whole
one, since cards before it have no SYSTEM.

---

ChaOS 0.9.2 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.2-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.2-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
